devices.note: the shipped desktop game: nothing is applied
Steam Deck class: a 7-inch 1280x800 (16:10) panel at 60 Hz, 4 Zen 2 cores / 8 threads, RDNA2 8 CUs; the project's base size is already 1280x800, so the window is the panel 1:1
the Deck at its 40 Hz battery mode (the quick access menu's refresh / frame limit 40): 25 ms frames, the sim still ticks at 60 Hz
the Deck's profile uncapped (vsync off, max_fps 0): the simulator's headroom measure, never a play mode
study: deck_bench at the desktop's zoom (zoom_k 1.0): the A side of the zoom cost A/B (E6)
study: deck_bench drawn at 0.75 of the 1280x800 base (960x600) and scaled up to the panel (viewport stretch): the fill-rate lever of E8
study: deck_bench drawn at 0.85 of the 1280x800 base (1088x680) and scaled up to the panel (viewport stretch): the gentler step of E8

the Deck row drawn at 0.75 of the 1280x800 base (960x600) and scaled up to the panel (viewport stretch), the camera px/m x 0.75 so the framing is the deck row's: the E8 fill-rate lever as a play row, for the owner's look call
Windows handheld class (Ryzen Z1/Z2 or Lunar Lake class APUs, 7 to 8.8-inch 1920x1080 panels): runs the Windows build; stretch_mode viewport draws at the 1280x800 base and scales up
study: handheld_1080 drawn at the panel's own 1920x1080 (canvas_items, the desktop's mode): the A side of the viewport-stretch A/B
a budget only (no SDK, no device): a Switch-class handheld, 1280x720 (16:9) at 30 fps, 3 cores for the game; the simulator pins 3 threads on the integrated Radeon

doc: Handheld lane (docs/handheld/LEDGER.md): the device profile per target, picked by the launch flag --device=<id> (a dash in the id reads as an underscore: --device=switch-handheld). The default `desktop` applies nothing: the shipped game is untouched. A row may set window_w/window_h (the window's size in px: the device's panel), max_fps (Engine.max_fps; 0 = uncapped), vsync (enabled, disabled, adaptive, mailbox), stretch_mode (canvas_items = draw at the window's size, the shipped mode; viewport = draw at the project's 1280x800 base and scale the image up: a fill-rate lever for a 1080p panel), zoom_k (the camera's px/m x this: a 7-inch panel at arm's length shows a metre at about half the visual angle of a desktop monitor; the handheld rows take 1.25 = 40 px/m, the owner's pick of 2026-11-07), rumble (the pad rumble gain 0..1, HandheldRumble on the Events bus; absent = none), tier (full or handheld: the effect tier the views may read). sim_threads and sim_gpu are for the PC simulator only (tools/handheld/sim.mjs): the logical CPUs the process is pinned to and the GPU class it renders on (integrated = the CPU's own Radeon, weaker than a Deck's).
